segments.text: The First Epistle of the Blessed Clement, the Disciple of Peter the Apostle.

To all those who love and cherish their life in Christ through God the Father, and obey the truth of God in hope of eternal life; to those who bear affection towards their brethren and towards their neighbours in the love of God; to the blessed virgins, who devote themselves to preserve virginity “for the sake of the kingdom of heaven;” and to the holy virgins: the peace which is in God.
